operations.description: Get a list of all subscription definitions for the portal
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] communication preferences v 3 definitions page [PATH] communication preferences v 3 definitions [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] definition definitions response subscription

operations.description: Returns a list of subscriptions and their status for a given contact.
operations.summary: Get subscription statuses for a contact
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] communication preferences v 3 status email email address email status [PATH] communication preferences v 3 status email [PARAMS] address email [SCHEMA] public response status statuses subscription

operations.description: Subscribes a contact to the given subscription type. This API is not valid to use for subscribing a contact at a brand or portal level and will return an error.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] communication preferences v 3 subscribe subscribe [PATH] communication preferences v 3 subscribe [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] public request status subscription update

operations.description: Unsubscribes a contact from the given subscription type. This API is not valid to use for unsubscribing a contact at a brand or portal level and will return an error.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] communication preferences v 3 unsubscribe unsubscribe [PATH] communication preferences v 3 unsubscribe [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] public request status subscription update
